About Us

Get to know the people and work behind Wahi Properties Ltd.

Who We Are

Wahi Properties Ltd is a real estate developer based in Dhaka. We build residential flats in and around the city for people looking for a home. We also work with landowners who want to develop their property through a joint venture.

About Joint Ventures
Mr. Md. Wahidul IslamFounder

Our Story

30 years ago, Mr. Md. Wahidul Islam founded Wahi Properties Ltd. As the business grew, his father, the late Md. Badsha Mia, stood by him and supported the company in every way he could. Today, Wahi continues to build homes in and around Dhaka.
